title: Version 2.1.150 - Infrastructure Improvements
description: Internal infrastructure improvements with no user-facing changes. Recent releases (2.1.128-2.1.149) included keyboard-friendly diff scrolling, GFM task list rendering, enhanced usage insights, improved auto-updater, and the `/code-review` command replacing `/simplify`.

title: Version 2.1.149 - Enhanced Usage Insights & UI Improvements
description: `/usage` now shows per-category breakdown of limits usage. `/diff` detail view can be scrolled with keyboard. Markdown renders GFM task list checkboxes. Added `allowAllClaudeAiMcps` managed setting. Fixed multiple security issues including PowerShell permission bypass and sandbox write allowlist issues.

title: Version 2.1.147 - Background Sessions & Code Review
description: Pinned background sessions (Ctrl+T) now stay alive when idle. Renamed `/simplify` to `/code-review` with effort level support. Improved auto-updater with network failure retries and better error reporting. Enhanced diff rendering performance for large file edits.

title: Version 0.133.0 - Richer Context & Goal Mode Default
description: Goals are now enabled by default, backed by dedicated storage, and track progress across active turns. Enhanced richer context understanding of work context. Improved browser capabilities with remote locked use security features and appshots functionality.

title: Version 0.132.0
description: Codex CLI version 0.132.0 released on May 20, 2026.

title: Version 0.131.0
description: Codex CLI version 0.131.0 released on May 18, 2026.

title: 2026 Release Updates - Platform Default Settings & Integration Improvements
description: Platform default settings for Linux/Windows, Slack channel override, MCP OAuth resource parameter support, GitLab interactive PR review, PR Review Status API, in-app support dialog, inline repo permission toggle, enterprise max concurrent snapshot builds, GitLab OAuth scope and token refresh, network config editor redesign, and numerous other improvements across automations, integrations, and MCP marketplace.

title: Version 2.1.145 - Agent View JSON Output
description: Added `claude agents --json` for listing live sessions as JSON. Added agent_id and parent_agent_id to OTEL spans. `/plugin` Discover screens now show plugin components before installation. Status line JSON includes GitHub repo and PR information.

title: Version 2.1.144 - Background Session Resume Support
description: Added `/resume` support for background sessions with elapsed duration notifications. `/plugin` browse shows last updated timestamps. `/model` changes model for current session only. Fixed startup hanging up to 75s when api.anthropic.com unreachable.

title: Version 2.1.142 - Fast Mode Opus 4.7 Default
description: Fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default (previously Opus 4.6). Added new `claude agents` flags for configuration. Plugins with root-level SKILL.md surfaced as skills. Fixed MCP tool timeout issues and background session clock jump detection on macOS sleep/wake.

title: Session Organization & Enterprise Features
description: Collapsible session folders in sidebar, archive all sessions option, Sub-Devin session filter, default member roles for enterprise, GHES app registration restriction, copyable organization ID, admin-enforced settings lock icon, MCP OAuth client credentials, Tavily MCP in marketplace, PR actions and auto-review settings, and various improvements.

title: Version 2.1.139 - Agent View & Goal Command
description: Added agent view (Research Preview) with `claude agents` command showing all sessions. Added `/goal` command to set completion conditions. Added `/scroll-speed` command. Added `claude plugin details` to show component inventory. Added transcript view navigation shortcuts.

title: Visual Studio April 2026 Update - Agentic Workflows
description: Cloud agent sessions that launch directly from the IDE. Enhanced custom agents capabilities. Improved integration with Visual Studio workflows.

title: April 2026 Policy Changes - AI Training Data Usage
description: Starting April 24, 2026, GitHub began using Copilot interactions (inputs, outputs, and code snippets) to train and improve their AI models. Major restructuring of Copilot plans for individual developers as of April 20, 2026.

title: Copilot CLI Version 1.0.52-4 Update
description: Smoother conversation view with vertical scrollbar drag support. Fixes for session and command-flow issues. Various bug fixes and improvements.

title: Devin 2.2 Launch - Desktop Testing
description: Devin 2.2 with 3x faster startup time, new UI connecting dev lifecycle, smoother Slack and Linear integrations. Full desktop testing support for Linux apps with computer use QA capabilities. Existing users can enable Desktop mode in settings.

title: Version 1.2.1 (VS Code) & 1.0.38 (JetBrains) - Summer 2025
description: Enhanced AI model support and error tracking. GPT-5 support added. Continue runs AI checks on every pull request with GitHub status checks and suggested fixes.

title: Version 0.86.x - GPT-5 and Grok-4 Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models and Grok-4 via xai/grok-4 and openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 model names. Added reasoning_effort setting for GPT-5 models. Disabled temperature by default for GPT models. Aider wrote 62% of the code in this release.

title: Windsurf Next - Opt-in Prerelease Version
description: Introduced Windsurf Next, an opt-in prerelease version of the Windsurf Editor for early access to bleeding-edge features.

title: New AI Models - DeepSeek R1, V3, and OpenAI o3-mini
description: Added support for DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek V3, and OpenAI o3-mini models in the Windsurf Editor.

title: Wave 2 - Second Batch of Windsurf Editor Updates
description: Wave 2 update batch for Windsurf Editor with new features and improvements to the AI-native IDE experience.
